'''Vereeto''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] who served the [[Republic Army]] on the snowy [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
Vereeto first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].
